characters.summary: Lucius Fox is a brilliant corporate executive, inventor, and engineer who supports Batman by managing Wayne Enterprises and designing high-tech gear, vehicles, and security systems. He generally avoids direct physical combat, relying on his formidable intellect, advanced technology, and business acumen.
limitations: Relies on external operatives for direct physical confrontations

sources.supports: Role as Wayne Enterprises CEO, inventor, and ally to Batman supplying technology.

campaignTags.claim: Designs and oversees the creation of advanced technologies and equipment for Wayne Enterprises and Batman.
Expert in advanced technology, engineering, and corporate computer networks.

unknowns: Exact combat proficiency in specific non-canon storylines.

characters.summary: J'onn J'onzz is a powerhouse alien refugee possessing superhuman strength, speed, durability, flight, invisibility, intangibility, shape-shifting, and profound telepathic and telekinetic abilities. He is one of the most versatile and powerful members of the Justice League, though historically vulnerable to fire.
weaknesses: Psychological or physiological vulnerability to fire
limitations: Vulnerability to fire can inhibit his powers and cause severe panic or weakness.

sources.supports: Abilities including shape-shifting, flight, telepathy, super-strength, intangibility, and vulnerability to fire.

notableResults.note: Fought to a standstill; their overall power levels are frequently depicted as comparable.

campaignTags.claim: Innate ability to fly at hypersonic speeds.
Can render his molecular structure invisible at will.
Extremely powerful telepath capable of reading, controlling, and communicating with minds globally.
Demonstrated psionic manipulation of physical objects.
Can regenerate lost mass and heal from severe physical damage.

unknowns: Extent of telepathic resistance in various cosmic entities.

characters.continuity: DC Comics, JLA: Trial by Fire
characters.summary: Fernus is the primal, genocidal personality of the Martian race unleashed when J'onn J'onzz overcomes his ancestral fear of fire. Fernus possesses all of Martian Manhunter's vast physical and mental powers, amplified significantly, alongside the terrifying ability to project and control hellfire.
weaknesses: Vulnerability to specialized psychic countermeasures and extreme telepathic assault
limitations: Prone to extreme arrogance and sadistic bloodlust.
characters.formDifferences: Removes the vulnerability to fire, unlocks burning fire-control abilities, and significantly increases aggression and offensive power output.

sources.supports: Fernus persona as the ancient, fire-immune burning Martian form of J'onn J'onzz.

notableResults.note: Easily overpowered multiple members of the Justice League before being defeated through specific psychological and environmental countermeasures.

campaignTags.claim: Retains all of J'onn's innate flight capabilities at heightened levels.
Projects and weaponizes intense burning Martian fire.
Exerts overwhelming planetary-scale telepathic dominance.
Advanced biological regeneration capable of recovering from catastrophic trauma.

characters.summary: Scott Free is the greatest escape artist in the universe, originating from New Genesis. He utilizes Mother Box technology, high-tech gadgets, exceptional acrobatics, and tactical genius to escape any trap and overcome cosmic adversaries.

mechanisms: New God physiology (enhanced durability and strength)
Mother Box healing and life support

weaknesses: Prone to emotional empathy and psychological burdens
limitations: Relies heavily on standard New God physical stats rather than raw cosmic-destroying energy projection.

sources.supports: Escape artist skills, New God physiology, Mother Box utilization, and technological gear.

notableResults.note: Overcame her traps and training through superior escape mastery.

conditional.ability: Boom tube teleportation and advanced life support

campaignTags.claim: Utilizes aero-pads or Mother Box tech to achieve flight.
Carries extensive escape tools, energy disruptors, and a sentient Mother Box.
Uses Mother Box capabilities for boom tube teleportation.

unknowns: Full potential if completely separated from New Genesis technology.

characters.summary: Mister Mxyzptlk is a mischievous fifth-dimensional imp with near-omnipotent reality-warping powers. He can alter reality, matter, and physics on a whim, limited only by his own whimsical rules and the self-imposed condition that saying his name backwards sends him back to the fifth dimension.
weaknesses: Compelled by self-imposed or magical rules (such as tricking him into saying his name backwards)
limitations: Can be tricked into pronouncing his name backwards, which banishes him to the fifth dimension for a designated period.

sources.supports: Fifth-dimensional imp status, reality-warping abilities, and the name-backward weakness.

notableResults.note: Defeated repeatedly when Superman tricks him into saying 'Kltpzyxm' (Mxyzptlk backwards).

campaignTags.claim: Innate ability to hover and fly through space and dimensions.
Instantly teleports across dimensions and locations without restriction.

unknowns: True limits of his fifth-dimensional power when unleashed without amusement-seeking constraints.

characters.summary: Dr. Victor Fries is a cryogenic scientist who uses a specialized refrigerated suit to survive sub-zero temperatures. He commits crimes using powerful freeze guns and cryogenic weaponry to fund his research to cure his frozen wife, Nora.
weaknesses: Must remain in sub-zero environments or within his refrigerated suit; warm temperatures cause physical collapse
mobility: Standard terrestrial movement via powered exoskeleton
limitations: Complete dependence on his containment suit; breaching the suit leads to rapid incapacitation in normal room temperatures.

sources.supports: Cryogenic suit requirement, freeze gun technology, and physiological dependence on sub-zero temperatures.

notableResults.citation: Batman: Detective Comics / various graphic novels
notableResults.note: Frequently defeated when Batman exploits weaknesses in his cryogenic suit or cuts off his coolant supply.

campaignTags.claim: Wears a heavy life-support exoskeleton that grants superhuman strength and durability.
Wields advanced cryogenic rifles and freeze guns.
Master scientist who engineered his own freezing technology and survival suit.
Expert in cryonics and advanced mechanical engineering.

unknowns: Efficacy of freeze weapons against cosmic-tier entities.

characters.summary: Dick Grayson is the original Robin turned independent hero Nightwing. He is a master acrobat, exceptional martial artist, and tactical leader who fights crime using escrima sticks, winged gliders, and supreme hand-to-hand combat skills.

techniques: Escrima stick strikes and electricity discharge

weaknesses: Standard human physiological vulnerability to high-caliber trauma
limitations: Human physical limits; relies entirely on skill, speed, and gear rather than superpowers.

sources.supports: Acrobatic skills, martial arts mastery, escrima sticks, and superhero career as former Robin.

notableResults.note: Has engaged in numerous competitive bouts with Deathstroke, resulting in wins and losses depending on tactical preparation.

campaignTags.claim: Utilizes glider wings built into his costume to glide across urban environments.
Carries utility belt items, grappling hooks, and concussive charges.
Trained by Batman in stealth, infiltration, and silent takedowns.

unknowns: Performance against opponents with overwhelming superhuman durability without specialized gear.

characters.summary: Orm Marius, the Ocean Master, is Aquaman's half-brother and rival for the throne of Atlantis. He is a powerful warrior equipped with mystical Atlantean artifacts, magical tridents that manipulate energy and weather, and advanced underwater combat prowess.
weaknesses: Arrogance and emotional instability regarding his birthright and royal status
limitations: Relies heavily on his magical trident for high-end energy and weather projection.

sources.supports: Atlantean physiology, magical trident usage, weather control, and royal rivalry with Aquaman.

notableResults.note: Frequently defeated by Aquaman in battles for the crown of Atlantis.

campaignTags.claim: Atlantean royalty fully adapted to deep-sea combat and pressure.
Can breathe underwater naturally.
Possesses high-speed swimming capabilities characteristic of elite Atlanteans.
Wields a magical trident capable of generating powerful electrical blasts.
Uses enchanted tridents and talismans to channel magical attacks and weather control.

unknowns: Combat effectiveness if permanently disarmed of his magical trident.
